description: This Java class defines the service `LoanCalculateRepaymentPastDueService`, which calculates the total past due amounts for loan repayments, including principal, interest, fees, and penalties, for a specific loan. It retrieves relevant installments that are overdue as of the current date and sums their outstanding amounts.

classes.name: LoanCalculateRepaymentPastDueService
classes.description: Service class for calculating past due loan repayment amounts, including methods for retrieving and summing overdue installments.

methods.name: retrieveLoanRepaymentPastDueAmountTillDate
methods.description: Public method that retrieves overdue repayments for a loan and calculates the total past due amounts.

methods.name: calculatePastDueAmountsForRepayments
methods.description: Private method that sums up overdue amounts across a list of installments, broken down by principal, interest, fees, and penalties.

methods.name: getPastDueRepayments
methods.description: Private method that filters the list of loan repayment installments to find those that are overdue as of the current business date.
